bullets.text: The State government ordered civic agencies in Chennai and suburbs to finish flood mitigation work by October 15, and the office should monitor progress.
Residents held a midnight road protest in Vadaperumbakkam near Sengundram over power cuts, arguing with police, and the office should watch local electricity supply.
Adambakkam railway station remains closed seven months after the MRTS extension opened, disappointing locals, and the office should press for trains to stop there.
Bill Gates warned that AI could risk one billion lives during a press meet that also covered political news, and the office should note technology risks.
Southern Railway urged the Chief Secretary to relocate 43 Tasmac shops near railway stations and tracks due to safety issues, and the office should coordinate action.
One hundred and fifty families continue to live in unsafe buildings in Velachery despite court warnings, and the office should monitor evacuation efforts for safety.
Ongoing underground sewerage work and a damaged carriageway on the Velachery-Tambaram High Road slowed traffic significantly, and the office should push for repairs.
Avadi police arrested a Village Administrative Officer and an assistant for taking an ₹8,000 bribe for a legal heir certificate, and the office should crack down on graft.
Zoho's Sridhar Vembu expressed concern over poor road infrastructure in the Ambத்தூர் industrial estate, which supports many jobs, and the office should prioritize upgrades.
Police arrested three men and seized over 52 kg of banned gutkha in Ponneri, and the office should watch local enforcement against illegal tobacco.
TIDCO invited tenders for a ₹400 crore digital finance centre in Coimbatore to boost fintech, and the office should track progress on the new hub.
Starbucks will establish its first India Global Capability Centre in Chennai, creating 800 jobs, and the office should support this IT and corporate expansion.
CtrlS and Ciena partnered to build high-speed data centre networks across five Indian cities offering up to 100 Tb/s capacity, and the portfolio team should monitor infrastructure growth.
The TVK government rolled back key announcements following public opposition, and the office should track policy adjustments and public feedback.
Minister Rajmohan commented that changing the election commissioner is not a solution, and the office should note the political stance.
A scheme providing gold rings from the maternal uncle to newborns in Chennai government hospitals was launched, and the office should track rollout details.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to launch metro rail services, and the office should prepare for the official event.
